outline:
使修習者對於大地工程有基本認識，應用土壤力學理論於工程實務。
Foundation Engineering
This course introduce the design considerations of some fundemantal and simple geotechnical structures based on the application of soil mechanics, with pratcial exercise. A series of design tasks for slope protection, including retaining wall, cut and drainage, anchors are  requested.
schedule:
W01-W04:側向土壓力、擋土牆分析與設計
W05-W07:邊坡穩定分析、STABL與SWEDGE程式應用
W08-W09:地錨與岩釘
W10-W12:隧道洞口與開挖整坡
W13-W15:水土保持與排水設計
W16:緩衝
W17-W18:學期成果發表與交流
assessment:
作業與報告60%
課堂參與15%
考試25%
